# NoC_Topology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-31

## Definition
The arrangement of on-chip routers and links that defines the communication graph among processing elements in a wafer-scale system. In TCC, the NoC topology is not just transport infrastructure but the central computational structure that data movement is organized around.
